claims.claim: Argon AI turned a short prompt about Imminence into a playable game about a vast presence arriving in a suburb.
claims.episode_span: Imagine typing one short paragraph about a mysterious, enormous presence slowly arriving in an ordinary neighborhood, and an AI instantly creates a playable game that captures that exact feeling without making it scary or sad. That's what happened with a new AI system called Argon.
claims.source_title: Ethan Mollick post on Argon AI game
claims.supporting_quote: Argon is quite different: "A game about Imminence. Something very big, very strange is happening. A suburb & the arrival of a vast & unknowable presence. Not horror, invoke the feeling of the end of all things coming, inevitably, but also not sad or scary"
